note: ECG recorded from the real simulation with the page's own frame loop (speed 2), with the ordinary beat as a conduction sweep: 12 leads (I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1 to V6) as whole hundredths of a millivolt, 250 samples per second; the excited fraction per frame (kept about every 12 ms of simulated time); the start times of ordinary beats and of extra beats. Made for the rhythm analyser's tests (tests/audio/rhythm.test.ts).
